limitations: No complete Node, Deno, or Bun upstream campaign has passed.
The maintained facade integration is validated here in Node only; earlier direct application controls cover Deno and local rebuilt Bun separately.
Linker warnings for unused libuv internals remain unresolved; tested APIs do not establish support for those paths.
Custom libraries, native embedding, additional objects, and explicit runtime search paths retain standalone Wasm linking.
The shared runtime is opt-in maintainer infrastructure, not yet integrated into the npm package application path.
Native macOS, Windows, ARM64, and stock Bun full-suite validation remain outstanding.
